platform.description: Platform ID (GUID) or name. This is an optional argument. When not specified, the current platform is used.

source.description: Source ID (GUID), name, or path. The source must be a child of the sound.

description: Sets which version of the source is being used for the specified sound. Use \ref ak_wwise_core_object_get with the 'activeSource' return option to get the active source of a sound.

examples.description: Setting the active source for a Sound Voice. The Sound has a main source and an alternate source.
examples.title: Setting the active source for a Sound Voice.
